title: They Know Where It Is, But Not What It Says: A Bilingual Hallucination Benchmark of Hadith Recall in Open LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.02587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly consulted for religious knowledge, including the recall of specific Hadith (recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Unlike open-ended generation, Hadith recall is a high-stakes, verifiable task: a reference (collection, chapter, and Hadith number) has exactly one correct text, and any deviation from it constitutes a fabrication that can be mistaken for authentic scripture. This study introduces a bilingual (English/Arabic) benchmark that probes five open-weight, locally-deployable language models (Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B, Jais-7B, ALLaM-7B, and Phi4-mini-3.8B) across all six canonical Sunni Hadith collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Da'ud, Jami' al-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah), sampling 500 Hadith per collection (3,000 per model per language, 30,000 responses total). translated_title: 它们知道圣训在哪里，却不知道它说了什么：开放大语言模型圣训召回的双语幻觉基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于查询宗教知识，包括召回特定的圣训（Hadith，即记录先知穆罕默德言行的话语与事迹）。与开放式生成不同，圣训召回是一项高风险且可验证的任务：一个出处（圣训集、章节和圣训编号）对应唯一正确的文本，任何偏离都构成伪造，且可能被误认为是真实的经文。本研究引入了一个双语（英语/阿拉伯语）基准，探测五个开放权重、可本地部署的语言模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B、Jais-7B、ALLaM-7B 和 Phi4-mini-3.8B），覆盖全部六部逊尼派正典圣训集（布哈里圣训实录、穆斯林圣训实录、艾布·达乌德圣训集、提尔米济圣训集、奈萨仪圣训集、伊本·马哲圣训集），每部圣训集抽样500条圣训（每个模型每种语言3,000条回答，总计30,000条回答）。每个模型仅获得文献出处信息，并被要求重新……[摘要原文在此处截断]
tldr: 本研究构建了英阿双语基准，测试五个开源大模型在六部逊尼派正典圣训集中根据出处召回圣训原文的能力，揭示了这些模型在可验证的高风险宗教文本召回任务中存在严重的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a bilingual English/Arabic benchmark evaluating five open-weight LLMs on recalling exact Hadith texts from bibliographic references across all six canonical Sunni collections, revealing severe hallucination in this high-stakes, verifiable religious recall task.
